agent_processing.zh: 🤖 Python 智能体正在处理请求...

config_title.zh: Python 智能体配置（Unity 只负责传递配置，不直接调用大语言模型）
config_title.en: Python Agent Config (Unity only passes config, does not call LLM directly)

config_system_prompt_label.zh: 额外系统提示词（会作为用户附加提示词传给 Python，由 Python 构建最终提示词）
config_system_prompt_label.en: Extra System Prompt (passed to Python as user constraints, Python builds final Prompt)

dialog_env_error_msg.zh:
无法连接到 Python 智能体服务。可能是缺少 Python 环境或依赖包。

是否打开【环境配置向导】进行自动修复？
dialog_env_error_msg.en:
Cannot connect to Python Agent Service. Python environment or dependency packages may be missing.

Do you want to open the [Environment Setup Wizard] for automatic repair?

err_bridge_not_running.zh: [错误] Unity 代理桥接器 (AgentBridge) 未能启动。请先确认控制台 (Console) 没有 C# 编译错误，然后执行菜单 AIBridge/Start Agent Bridge。
err_bridge_not_running.en: [Error] Unity AgentBridge failed to start. Please verify there are no C# compilation errors in Console, then run menu AIBridge/Start Agent Bridge.

err_service_not_running.zh: [错误] 无法启动或连接 Python 智能体服务，请确认系统可执行 python，并查看控制台输出。
err_service_not_running.en: [Error] Unable to start or connect to Python Agent Service. Please verify Python is executable and check Console output.

msg_session_started.zh: [Python 智能体] 会话已启动：{0}

err_session_start_failed.zh: [错误] Python 智能体服务未能启动会话：{0}
err_session_start_failed.en: [Error] Python Agent Service failed to start session: {0}

err_session_start_exception.zh: [错误] 启动 Python 智能体会话失败：{0}
err_session_start_exception.en: [Error] Failed to start Python Agent session: {0}

err_poll_timeout.zh: [错误] 长时间无法从 Python 智能体服务获取会话事件，已停止当前界面等待状态。
err_poll_timeout.en: [Error] Unable to get session events from Python Agent Service for a long time. Stopped waiting.

msg_session_terminated.zh: [系统] ⏹ 用户手动终止了智能体会话。
msg_session_terminated.en: [System] ⏹ Agent session manually terminated by user.

wizard_welcome_status.zh: 欢迎使用 AIBridge。在开始之前，我们需要检查您的 Python 环境。
wizard_welcome_status.en: Welcome to AIBridge. Before starting, we need to check your Python environment.

wizard_checking_status.zh: 准备检测 Python 环境...

wizard_python_not_found.zh: 未检测到 Python 运行环境 AIBridge 的后台智能体需要 Python 支持。
wizard_python_not_found.en: Python runtime environment not detected AIBridge's backend Agent requires Python support.

wizard_python_not_found_err.zh: 建议： 1. 点击下方按钮前往官网下载 Python (推荐 3.8+) 2. 安装时务必勾选 "将 Python 添加到环境变量 (Add Python to PATH)" 3. 安装完成后可能需要重启 Unity 或电脑
wizard_python_not_found_err.en: Suggestions: 1. Click the button below to download Python from the official site (3.8+ recommended) 2. Make sure to check "Add Python to PATH" during installation 3. Restart Unity or your computer after installation if needed

wizard_detecting_python.zh:
正在检测系统中的 Python...
(尝试命令: {0} --version)
wizard_detecting_python.en:
Checking Python in the system...
(Trying command: {0} --version)

wizard_python_detected.zh: 检测到 Python：{0} (命令: {1}) 准备检测必要的 Python 依赖包 (requests)...
wizard_python_detected.en: Detected Python: {0} (Command: {1}) Preparing to check required Python package (requests)...

wizard_all_set_status.zh: 环境配置完美！ - Python 启动命令: {0} - Python 版本: {1} - 依赖包: 全部就绪 您现在可以开始使用 AI 助手了。
wizard_all_set_status.en: Environment setup is perfect! - Python Startup Command: {0} - Python Version: {1} - Dependencies: All Ready You can now start using the AI Assistant.

wizard_missing_deps.zh: 检测到 Python ({0})，使用命令 `{1}`，但缺失必要的依赖包。 AIBridge 需要 `requests` 依赖库来与大语言模型 (LLM) 接口以及 Unity 进行 HTTP 通信。
wizard_missing_deps.en: Detected Python ({0}) using command `{1}`, but missing required dependency packages. AIBridge requires the `requests` library to communicate with LLM APIs and Unity via HTTP.

wizard_missing_deps_err.zh: 请点击下方「一键安装依赖」使用包管理工具 (pip) 进行安装。
wizard_missing_deps_err.en: Please click 'Install Dependencies' below to install via pip.

wizard_installing_deps.zh:
正在使用 pip 安装 requests 依赖库，请稍候...
这可能需要一两分钟，具体取决于您的网络状态。

(执行命令: {0} -m pip install requests)
wizard_installing_deps.en:
Installing requests library via pip, please wait...
This might take a minute or two depending on your network.

(Command: {0} -m pip install requests)

wizard_install_success.zh: 依赖安装成功！ - Python 启动命令: {0} - Python 版本: {1} - 依赖包: 全部就绪 您现在可以开始使用 AI 助手了。
wizard_install_success.en: Dependencies installed successfully! - Python Startup Command: {0} - Python Version: {1} - Dependencies: All Ready You can now start using the AI Assistant.

wizard_install_failed.zh: 依赖安装失败 可能是因为网络问题或包管理工具 (pip) 未正确配置。
wizard_install_failed.en: Dependency installation failed This might be due to network issues or pip not being properly configured.

wizard_skip_status.zh: 配置完成！ 虽然跳过了依赖安装，您仍可以尝试运行智能体。
wizard_skip_status.en: Setup completed! Although dependency installation was skipped, you can still try running the Agent.

wizard_timeout.zh: 操作超时 (可能命令被阻止或弹出窗口)
wizard_timeout.en: Operation timeout (command might be blocked or prompt popped up)

step_request_llm_decision.zh: [步骤 {0}/{1}] 请求大语言模型决策

err_no_content_or_tool.zh: [智能体] 模型未返回文本内容，也没有工具调用。
err_no_content_or_tool.en: [Agent] Model returned no content and no tool calls.

err_max_steps_reached.zh: [智能体] 已达到最大步骤数 {0}，请检查是否存在循环调用或工具错误。
err_max_steps_reached.en: [Agent] Max steps {0} reached, please check for infinite loops or tool errors.

err_bridge_offline.zh:
[智能体错误] {0} 代理桥接器 (AgentBridge) 未连接，已停止本次会话。
请先确认宿主应用已启动 AgentBridge 服务，且 Python 端可访问 {1}/ping。
err_bridge_offline.en:
[Agent Error] {0} AgentBridge is offline, session stopped.
Please ensure that the host app has started the AgentBridge service and Python can access {1}/ping.

err_bridge_offline_during_tool.zh: [智能体错误] {0} 代理桥接器 (AgentBridge) 已离线，本次会话停止，避免继续卡在工具调用。
err_bridge_offline_during_tool.en: [Agent Error] {0} AgentBridge went offline, session stopped to prevent hanging on tool call.

msg_detecting_service.zh: 正在检测 Python Agent Service 与 Unity 执行端...
msg_detecting_service.en: Checking Python Agent Service and Unity command bridge...

msg_service_check_failed.zh: Python Agent Service 检测异常：{0}

msg_service_no_response.zh: Python Agent Service 未能启动或未响应。请检查 Python 路径、run_agent_service.py、端口占用和依赖安装。
msg_service_no_response.en: Python Agent Service is not responding. Check Python path, run_agent_service.py, port usage, and dependencies.

msg_check_completed.zh: 检测完成：Python Agent Service 正常，Unity 执行端可用。
msg_check_completed.en: Check completed: Python Agent Service is healthy and Unity command bridge is available.

dialog_detect_success.zh: 检测成功：Python Agent Service 与 Unity 执行端均可用。
dialog_detect_success.en: Success: Python Agent Service and Unity command bridge are available.

msg_bridge_not_ready.zh: Python Agent Service 已可用，但 Unity 执行端未就绪。发送任务前请确认 AgentBridge 服务能正常启动。
msg_bridge_not_ready.en: Python Agent Service is available, but Unity command bridge is not ready. Make sure AgentBridge can start before sending tasks.

dialog_detect_bridge_not_ready.zh: Python Agent Service 可用，但 Unity 执行端未就绪。详情已写入会话。
dialog_detect_bridge_not_ready.en: Python Agent Service is available, but Unity command bridge is not ready. Details were added to the session.

config_subtitle.zh: （Unity 只负责执行命令，不直接调用 LLM）
config_subtitle.en: (Unity only executes commands; Python handles LLM calls)

empty_chat_hint.zh: 输入任务后，Python Agent 会在这里显示执行过程与结果。
empty_chat_hint.en: After entering a task, the Python Agent will display the execution process and results here.

cmd_panel_subtitle.zh: 搜索、分类、手动执行 Unity 命令
cmd_panel_subtitle.en: Search, categorize, and execute Unity commands manually

tooltip_refresh_cmds.zh: 重新扫描 Unity 执行命令列表
tooltip_refresh_cmds.en: Rescan the list of Unity executable commands

msg_commands_refreshed.zh: 已刷新 Unity 执行命令列表。
